company.name: NewsCatcher
company.shortDescription: NewsCatcher is a news API that provides news articles and information services
company.description: NewsCatcher is the go-to solution for professionals needing reliable, accurate, and timely news data. In an era where businesses depend on AI and LLMs, quality data is critical to maintaining a competitive edge. NewsCatcher delivers clean, normalized, near-real-time news from over 70,000 global sources, covering 98% of each site, including hyper-local content. Our enriched data includes sentiment scores, named entity detection, and clustering, minimizing post-processing needs. We tailor automated news systems for specific sectors and regions, ensuring relevance and integration into existing workflows. With transparent data collection processes, we empower businesses to stay informed and ahead in their industry.
